subject: Fitting a 3-group growth curve model using lavaan

messages.author: fefaa979d9609ad1
messages.subject: Fitting a 3-group growth curve model using lavaan
parts:
I am trying to fit a 3-group growth curve model using lavaan. Here is my code:

    library(RCurl); library(lavaan)

    instantiation_growth <- getURL("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aronlindberg/midrange_citation_analysis/master/data/instantiation.csv")
    instantiation_growth <- read.csv(text = instantiation_growth)
    instantiation_growth <- instantiation_growth[,9:29]
    colnames(instantiation_growth) <- c("t1", "t2", "t3", "t4", "t5", "t6", "t7", "t8", "t9", "t10", "t11", "t12", "t13", "t14", "t15", "t16", "t17", "t18", "t19", "t20")

    modification_growth <-    getURL("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aronlindberg/midrange_citation_analysis/master/data/modification.csv")
    modification_growth <- read.csv(text = modification_growth)
    modification_growth <- modification_growth[,9:29]
    colnames(modification_growth) <- c("t1", "t2", "t3", "t4", "t5", "t6", "t7", "t8", "t9", "t10", "t11", "t12", "t13", "t14", "t15", "t16", "t17", "t18", "t19", "t20")

    extension_growth <- getURL("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aronlindberg/midrange_citation_analysis/master/data/extension.csv")
    extension_growth <- read.csv(text = extension_growth)
    extension_growth <- extension_growth[,9:29]
    colnames(extension_growth) <- c("t1", "t2", "t3", "t4", "t5", "t6", "t7", "t8", "t9", "t10", "t11", "t12", "t13", "t14", "t15", "t16", "t17", "t18", "t19", "t20")

    a.vector <- rep("Instantiation", nrow(instantiation_growth))
    instantiation_growth$type <- a.vector

    b.vector <- rep("Modification", nrow(modification_growth))
    modification_growth$type <- b.vector

    c.vector <- rep("Extension", nrow(extension_growth))
    extension_growth$type <- c.vector

    growth_data <- rbind(instantiation_growth, modification_growth, extension_growth)

    # Multi-group Growth model
    model <- ' i =~ 1*t2 + 1*t3 + 1*t4 + 1*t5 + 1*t6 + 1*t7 + 1*t8 + 1*t9 + 1*t10 + 1*t11 + 1*t12 + 1*t13+ 1*t14 + 1*t15 + 1*t16 + 1*t17 + 1*t18 + 1*t19 + 1*t20
    s =~ 0*t2 + 1*t3 + 2*t4 + 3*t5 + 4*t6 + 5*t7 + 6*t8 + 7*t9 + 8*t10 + 9*t11 + 10*t12 + 11*t13 + 12*t14 + 13*t15 + 14*t16 + 15*t17 + 16*t18 + 17*t19 + 18*t20'
    fit_constrained <- growth(model, data=growth_data, group = "type", group.equal = c("means"))
    fit_UNconstrained <- growth(model, data=growth_data, group = "type")
    summary(fit_constrained)
    summary(fit_UNconstrained)

However, this returns:

    Error in svd(X) : infinite or missing values in 'x'
    In addition: Warning messages:
    1: In lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label,  :
      lavaan WARNING: small number of observations (nobs < nvar) in group 1
      nobs = 3 nvar = 19
    2: In lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label,  :
      lavaan WARNING: small number of observations (nobs < nvar) in group 2
      nobs = 1 nvar = 19
    3: In lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label,  :
      lavaan WARNING: small number of observations (nobs < nvar) in group 3
      nobs = 0 nvar = 19
    4: In lav_samplestats_from_data(lavdata = lavdata, missing =     lavoptions$missing,  :
      lavaan WARNING sample covariance can not be inverted in group: 1
    5: In lav_samplestats_from_data(lavdata = lavdata, missing =     lavoptions$missing,  :
      lavaan WARNING sample covariance can not be inverted in group: 2

I then do `View(growth_data)` and there everything looks fine.

What does `lavaan` mean that it says that I only have 3, 1, and 0 observations in each of the groups respectively?

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: Fitting a 3-group growth curve model using lavaan
parts:
I would guess the issue is that by default lavaan is using listwise deletion with your data. Try adding missing = "ml" for FIML estimation.

Alex
